title: EDR and anti-malware
question: Do all of your endpoints have endpoint detection and response (EDR) or anti-malware protection?
headline: 1 of 4 devices (25.0%)
answer_text: 1 of 4 devices (25.0%) reports endpoint protection that Patched recognises. 3 devices are unknown (1 reported a security tool Patched does not recognise; 1 reported no security tool evidence; 1 has not reported in the last 14 days) and are not counted in your favour.
basis: Security tools each device reported, matched against the endpoint protection products Patched recognises and any you have added. Only a recognised product counts. A device that has not reported in the last 14 days is unknown.
